summary.goal: Define Plan and PlanVersion entities that capture intent and track version history
summary.context: A Plan is a container for versions. Each PlanVersion is a snapshot with goal, steps, and metadata. Versions progress through draft -> approved -> published states.

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan entity has plan_id, created_at, updated_at
PlanVersion has version number (monotonic within plan), status, summary, steps array
Summary includes goal and optional context
Status enum includes: draft, approved, published
Factory functions create valid Plan and PlanVersion instances

steps.title: Create project structure and dependencies
steps.description: Initialize TypeScript project with Zod, vitest. Create src/domain/ directory structure.

acceptance_criteria.description: package.json has typescript, zod, vitest dependencies

steps.title: Define PlanStatus enum and schema
steps.description: Create src/domain/status.ts with PlanStatus enum (draft, approved, published) and Zod schema.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanStatus enum exported with three values

steps.title: Define Summary interface and schema
steps.description: Create Summary type with goal (required) and context (optional). Define Zod schema.

acceptance_criteria.description: Summary interface has goal: string, context?: string

steps.title: Define Plan interface and schema
steps.description: Create src/domain/plan.ts with Plan interface: plan_id, created_at, updated_at. Include Zod schema.

acceptance_criteria.description: Plan interface has created_at: string (ISO date)
Plan interface has updated_at: string (ISO date)

steps.title: Define PlanVersion interface and schema
steps.description: Create PlanVersion interface: plan_id, version (number), status, summary, steps[], created_at, updated_at. Include Zod schema.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanVersion has steps: Step[] (empty array for now)

steps.title: Create Plan factory function
steps.description: Implement createPlan() factory that generates plan_id (UUID), sets timestamps. Validate with schema.

acceptance_criteria.description: created_at and updated_at are set to current time

steps.title: Create PlanVersion factory function
steps.description: Implement createPlanVersion(plan_id, goal, context?) factory. Sets version=1, status=draft, timestamps.

acceptance_criteria.description: Version is set to 1 for new versions

steps.title: Add unit tests for Plan entities
steps.description: Write vitest tests for Plan, PlanVersion schemas and factory functions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests verify schema validation (valid and invalid inputs)
Tests verify factory functions produce valid entities
Tests verify timestamps are set correctly
